name: Fish & Wildlife Grants
summary: Annual British Columbia grants for conservation, management and restoration of native freshwater fish, wildlife and their habitats, with on-the-ground habitat work strongly encouraged. Funding runs up to three years per cycle.

amount.note: Budgets typically range from $10,000 to over $100,000 a year

reporting: Grant reports are due annually on April 15th, covering activities completed by March 31st each year

status.quote: The Fish & Wildlife Grant is now open for application. The deadline to apply is November 6, 2026, at 4:30 pm (PT).

deadline.quote: The deadline to apply is November 6, 2026, at 4:30 pm (PT).

administered_by.quote: The Habitat Conservation Trust Foundation uses conditional grant agreements

applicant_types.quote: HCTF Fish & Wildlife (F&W) Grants are available to anyone (provincial or municipal governments, First Nations, academic institutions, non-government organizations, industry)

access.quote: Submission of HCTF Fish & Wildlife Grant Applications is through the HCTF Online application portal.

window.quote: Proposals are approved on an annual basis-a multi-year project must apply EACH YEAR for funding for the next year's activities.

amount.quote: F&W Grant budgets typically range from $10,000 to over $100,000 annually.

reporting.quote: Grant Reports are due annually on April 15th.
